description: Figure 2 illustrates the reliability scores of individual and ensemble models. The x-axis is labeled “Ensemble” and displays five categories: “GPT-3.5 + Opus”, “FT GPT-3.5 + GPT-4”, “FT GPT-3.5 + Opus”, “FT GPT-3.5 + Opus”, and “All”, with no specified scale or units. The y-axis is labeled with three metrics: “RS0”, “RS10”, and “RS10”, and ranges from 0 to 100 with a tick interval of 10.  There is one line plotted, colored black with circular markers. For the “GPT-3.5 + Opus” ensemble, the line begins at approximately 84.57 for RS0, increases to approximately 65.72 for RS10. For “FT GPT-3.5 + GPT-4”, the line starts at approximately 84.83 for RS0 and increases to approximately 71.97 for RS10. For “FT GPT-3.5 + Opus”, the line begins at approximately 85.08 for RS0 and increases to approximately 73.09 for RS10. For the second “FT GPT-3.5 + Opus” ensemble, the line starts at approximately 85.08 for RS0 and increases to approximately 73.09 for RS10. Finally, for the “All” ensemble, the line begins at approximately 82.6 for RS0 and increases to approximately 74.89 for RS10.
